transcript.text:
The `memory.bench` schema has two order-level tables: `orders` (current, with `order_id`, `customer_id`, `order_ts`, `status`, `amount`, `discount`) and `legacy_orders` (an older/legacy structure with `order_date` and `total`). `daily_region_revenue` is pre-aggregated (one row per day/region) and not transaction-level.

For individual customer order transactions (one row per order), the current, actively-structured table is `memory.bench.orders` — it has the finer-grained, up-to-date schema (timestamp, status, amount, discount) and represents the primary current transactional order data, while `legacy_orders` appears to be a deprecated/older version of the same concept.

FINAL ANSWER: memory.bench.orders
